hooks.name: Enforce Audit Rules Before Push
hooks.description: Validates audit-rules.spec.json configuration and checks for critical issues before any git push operation

action.command: powershell -Command "$input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($input -match 'git push') { if (Test-Path 'audit-rules.spec.json') { $config = Get-Content 'audit-rules.spec.json' | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($config.gates.prePush.enabled -eq $true) { Write-Host '{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"audit-rules.spec.json has pre-push gate enabled. Run audit before pushing.\"}}'; exit 0 } else { Write-Host 'Pre-push gate disabled in config.'; exit 0 } } else { Write-Error 'audit-rules.spec.json not found. Cannot validate push.'; exit 0 } } else { exit 0 }"
